title: What happened in AI — Oct 19, 2026
intro: DHS banned DeepSeek from federal civilian agencies, the day's main policy story, while a new V4.1-Flash-1017 build was reported.
Builders got more ways to check agents: Microsoft's Scope, Laminar's trace-error model and Google Cloud's judge-audit guide.
highlights: DHS bans DeepSeek across federal civilian agencies.
Microsoft open-sources Scope for evaluating coding agents.
Laminar trained flow-1 to catch silent agent failures in traces.
Modal: NVIDIA Vera CPUs complete far more sandbox tasks than x86 and Graviton.
vLLM scales Elastic Expert Parallelism with near-zero downtime.
Google releases EmbeddingGemma 2 under Apache 2.0, now multimodal.

categories.name: Evals and Observability for Agents
categories.summary: Four teams published tooling or practice for catching agent failures: open-source coding-agent evals, a trained trace-error model, judge audits and eval-gated shipping.

articles.title: Scope: Open-source evaluation for AI coding agents
articles.summary: Microsoft open-sources Scope, an evaluation framework for AI coding agents.

articles.title: Launch HN: Laminar (YC S24) – We trained a model to catch silent agent failures
articles.summary: Laminar says its RL-trained flow-1 model finds silent errors in agent traces; the observability tool is open source.

articles.title: Who judges the judge? Three helpful ways to audit your LLM evaluators
articles.summary: Google Cloud argues LLM judges are subjective too and lists three ways to audit your evaluators.

articles.title: How Numan Built an Eval-First AI Health Coach with LangGraph and LangSmith
articles.summary: Numan ships its Nu health coach on LangGraph and LangSmith with per-category evals, simulated conversations and safety gates.

categories.name: Agent Compute and Inference Infrastructure
categories.summary: Infrastructure posts target agent-shaped load: sandbox CPU throughput, MoE scaling without downtime, and small extraction and embedding models.

articles.title: NVIDIA Vera CPUs double throughput for Modal Sandboxes
articles.summary: Modal benchmarked NVIDIA's Arm-based Vera CPU on agentic Sandbox workloads; under heavy load it completed far more tasks than x86 and Graviton without hurting latency.

articles.title: Achieving near-zero-downtime scaling in Elastic Expert Parallelism
articles.summary: vLLM uses asynchronous preparation and NIXL EP to scale Elastic Expert Parallelism with near-zero downtime.

articles.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 Expands beyond Text to Support Code, Images, Video, and Audio
articles.summary: Google's Apache 2.0 EmbeddingGemma 2, built on Gemma 4, is a compact open-weight embedding model extended beyond text to code, images, video and audio.

articles.title: Cloudflare Introduces Clairic, a New Class of Extraction Models
articles.summary: Cloudflare announced Clairic, a new extraction model in its System One class.

categories.name: Agent Tooling and Pricing
categories.summary: Coding-agent workflows are moving toward parallel swarms and portable sessions, while per-call pricing appears beside token billing.

articles.title: Show HN: Acyclic – Rapid agent swarms. Agentic workflows exponentially faster
articles.summary: Acyclic (YC F26) splits a task across many coding agents, each in its own sandbox, and runs them as a swarm.

articles.title: How to continue a GitHub Copilot app session in VS Code
articles.summary: GitHub documents how to move an agent session from the Copilot app into VS Code while keeping conversation, code changes and context.

articles.title: Per-Call Pricing Just Entered the Agent Stack. Every Frontier Lab Still Charges by the Token.
articles.summary: Forkast reports per-call pricing has entered the agent stack while every frontier lab still bills by the token.

categories.name: DeepSeek Federal Ban and Fresh Release
categories.summary: DHS barred DeepSeek from federal civilian agencies on the same day a new Flash build was reported.

articles.title: Homeland Security Bans DeepSeek Use In Federal Civilian Agencies
articles.summary: Homeland Security bans DeepSeek use across federal civilian agencies.

articles.title: DeepSeek barred from government agency IT systems
articles.summary: Politico reports DeepSeek is barred from government agency IT systems.

articles.title: DeepSeek Quietly Ships V4.1-Flash-1017, Beating Rivals on Agent Tasks
articles.summary: Startup Fortune reports DeepSeek quietly shipped V4.1-Flash-1017, which it says beats rivals on agent tasks.
